tool.help:
**AlphaFold 3: Biomolecular Complex Prediction**
DeepMind's latest structure prediction model with 50%+ improvement over AlphaFold 2.
**Hardware Requirements:** - GPU Memory: ~80-100 GB (may work on NVIDIA GB10 with 120GB) - Disk Space: ~100 GB for model weights
**Capabilities:** - Protein structure prediction - Protein-protein complexes - Protein-DNA complexes - Protein-RNA complexes - Protein-ligand complexes - Ion binding sites
**Input JSON Format:** ```json { "sequences": [ {"protein": {"id": "A", "sequence": "MVLSPADKTN..."}}, {"ligand": {"id": "B", "smiles": "CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O"}} ] } ```
**License:** CC-BY-NC-SA (Non-commercial only)
**Alternative:** Use alphafold_api.xml for the EBI database (200M+ pre-computed structures)
**Citation:** Abramson et al. (2024). Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions. Nature.
